sections.title: OPINIONS, AGREEMENT, AND DISAGREEMENT
sections.instruction: Choose the expression that best completes each short conversation.

sections.title: SUGGESTIONS AND ADVICE
sections.instruction: Choose the most suitable suggestion, advice, or response.

sections.title: REQUESTS, OFFERS, AND INVITATIONS
sections.instruction: Choose the expression that fits the speaker's purpose and the reply.

sections.title: APOLOGIES, THANKS, COMPLIMENTS, AND CONGRATULATIONS
sections.instruction: Choose the most natural response in each situation.

sections.title: CLARIFICATION, PREFERENCES, AND POSSIBILITY
sections.instruction: Choose the expression that best completes the conversation.

questions.prompt:
A: “What do you think about the new school library?”
B: “____. It is quiet and has many useful books.”
choices: In my opinion, it is excellent.
I am sorry to hear that.
Could you show me the way?
questions.explanation:
Skill: Giving an Opinion.

Penjelasan: Jawaban A benar karena “In my opinion” digunakan untuk menyampaikan pendapat. Kalimat berikutnya menjelaskan alasan mengapa perpustakaan itu dianggap bagus.

questions.prompt:
A: “I think students should have more chances to take part in school activities.”
B: “____. Those activities help us learn new skills.”
choices: Would you like to join us?
questions.explanation:
Skill: Agreeing with an Opinion.

Penjelasan: Jawaban B benar karena “I couldn't agree more” berarti sangat setuju. Kalimat berikutnya mendukung pendapat tentang manfaat kegiatan sekolah.

questions.prompt:
A: “Group projects are always fair because everyone does the same amount of work.”
B: “____. Sometimes one student has to do most of the work.”
choices: I see your point, but I don't think that is always true.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Disagreeing Politely.

Penjelasan: Jawaban C benar karena ungkapan ini menunjukkan bahwa pembicara memahami pendapat orang lain, tetapi memiliki pendapat berbeda. Kata “but” memperkenalkan ketidaksetujuannya.

questions.prompt:
A: “____ about the new school uniform?”
B: “I think it looks neat and comfortable.”
questions.explanation:
Skill: Asking for an Opinion.

Penjelasan: Jawaban D benar karena “What do you think about ...?” digunakan untuk meminta pendapat seseorang tentang sesuatu.

questions.prompt:
A: “I'm worried about my upcoming English test.”
B: “____. You can review a little every day.”
choices: You should make a study schedule.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Giving Advice.

Penjelasan: Jawaban E benar karena “You should ...” digunakan untuk memberikan saran. Membuat jadwal belajar adalah saran yang sesuai untuk persiapan ujian.

questions.prompt:
A: “There is a lot of rubbish left after the school event.”
B: “____ organize a clean-up together?”
questions.explanation:
Skill: Making a Suggestion.

Penjelasan: Jawaban A benar karena “Why don't we ...?” digunakan untuk mengajak atau mengusulkan kegiatan bersama. Kegiatan yang diusulkan adalah membersihkan area sekolah.

questions.prompt:
A: “Let's practise the dialogue before the performance.”
B: “____. We need to speak clearly.”
choices: I don't think so. I have no time.
I'm afraid I can't invite you.
I have no idea what you mean.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Responding to a Suggestion.

Penjelasan: Jawaban B benar karena “That's a good idea” merupakan respons positif terhadap usulan. Kalimat berikutnya juga menunjukkan alasan untuk menerima usulan tersebut.

questions.prompt:
A: “I keep forgetting to bring my homework to school.”
B: “____ keep a checklist in your notebook.”
questions.explanation:
Skill: Giving Advice.

Penjelasan: Jawaban C benar karena “If I were you, I'd ...” digunakan untuk memberikan saran berdasarkan apa yang akan kita lakukan dalam situasi orang lain.

questions.prompt:
A: “____ open the window, please? It's quite warm in here.”
B: “Of course.”
questions.explanation:
Skill: Making a Polite Request.

Penjelasan: Jawaban D benar karena “Could you ...?” digunakan untuk meminta bantuan dengan sopan. Jawaban “Of course” menunjukkan bahwa permintaan tersebut diterima.

questions.prompt:
A: “These boxes look heavy.”
B: “____ carry one for you?”
A: “That would be great. Thank you.”
questions.explanation:
Skill: Offering Help.

Penjelasan: Jawaban E benar karena “Shall I ...?” dapat digunakan untuk menawarkan bantuan. Jawaban “That would be great” menunjukkan bahwa tawaran itu diterima.

questions.prompt:
A: “Would you like to join us for lunch after class?”
B: “____. Thank you for inviting me.”
questions.explanation:
Skill: Accepting an Invitation.

Penjelasan: Jawaban A benar karena “I'd love to” merupakan cara yang ramah untuk menerima undangan. Ucapan terima kasih setelahnya juga menunjukkan bahwa undangan diterima.

questions.prompt:
A: “Would you like to come to my birthday party on Saturday?”
B: “____. I have to visit my grandparents.”
choices: That sounds wonderful. I'll be there.
I'd love to, but I can't.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Declining an Invitation Politely.

Penjelasan: Jawaban B benar karena ungkapan ini menolak undangan dengan sopan. Bagian setelahnya memberikan alasan bahwa pembicara harus mengunjungi kakek dan neneknya.

questions.prompt:
A: “I'm sorry I returned your book late.”
B: “____. Thanks for bringing it back.”
choices: I don't know what to say.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Responding to an Apology.

Penjelasan: Jawaban C benar karena “That's all right” adalah ungkapan untuk menerima permintaan maaf dan menunjukkan bahwa masalahnya tidak perlu diperpanjang.

questions.prompt:
A: “Thank you for helping me prepare the presentation.”
B: “____. I'm happy I could help.”
questions.explanation:
Skill: Responding to Thanks.

Penjelasan: Jawaban D benar karena “You're welcome” merupakan respons umum ketika seseorang mengucapkan terima kasih.

questions.prompt:
A: “Your speech was clear and interesting.”
B: “____. I'm glad you enjoyed it.”
questions.explanation:
Skill: Responding to a Compliment.

Penjelasan: Jawaban E benar karena “Thank you” adalah respons yang sopan saat menerima pujian. Kalimat berikutnya menunjukkan bahwa pembicara menghargai komentar tersebut.

questions.prompt:
A: “I heard you won first prize in the science competition!”
B: “____. I'm really happy about it.”
choices: Thank you! I worked hard for it.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Responding to Congratulations.

Penjelasan: Jawaban A benar karena “Thank you” adalah respons yang tepat saat seseorang memberi selamat atas keberhasilan kita.

questions.prompt:
A: “Please write a short reflection on today's lesson.”
B: “____? Do you mean a summary of what I learned?”
A: “Yes, that's right.”
choices: Would you like to join us
Could you clarify what you mean by “reflection”
questions.explanation:
Skill: Asking for Clarification.

Penjelasan: Jawaban B benar karena “Could you clarify what you mean by ...?” digunakan untuk meminta penjelasan yang lebih jelas. Kalimat berikutnya menunjukkan bahwa siswa sedang memastikan arti kata “reflection”.

questions.prompt:
A: “First, submit the form online, then print the confirmation page.”
B: “Sorry, I didn't catch the last part. ____?”
questions.explanation:
Skill: Asking Someone to Repeat.

Penjelasan: Jawaban C benar karena “Could you repeat that, please?” digunakan ketika kita tidak mendengar atau tidak memahami ucapan seseorang dan ingin mendengarnya lagi.

questions.prompt:
A: “Would you rather work alone or with a partner?”
B: “____. I enjoy sharing ideas with other people.”
choices: I am not sure what you mean.
I'd rather work with a partner.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Expressing a Preference.

Penjelasan: Jawaban D benar karena “I'd rather ...” digunakan untuk menyatakan pilihan atau hal yang lebih disukai. Alasan setelahnya menunjukkan bahwa pembicara suka berbagi ide.

questions.prompt:
A: “Do you think the outdoor match will be cancelled?”
B: “____. The forecast says there may be heavy rain.”
questions.explanation:
Skill: Expressing Possibility.

Penjelasan: Jawaban E benar karena “It might be” menunjukkan kemungkinan, bukan kepastian. Prakiraan cuaca menyebutkan bahwa hujan lebat mungkin turun.
